product.material_description: hot-rolled carbon steel; exact grade and guaranteed minimum strength not published
product.application: metal framing/strut channel; not a published timber connection

nominal_wood_geometry_screen.assumed_hole_axis: centered in the screened face; not installed factory coordinates
nominal_wood_geometry_screen.loaded_edge_rule: 4D conditional perpendicular-to-grain screen; actual load direction and all other placement rules unresolved
nominal_wood_geometry_screen.interpretation: Broad face has a positive best-case edge reserve, but not a demonstrated installed fit. Narrow 1.5-inch face fails this screen for a centered half-inch bolt. End distance, bolt-row placement, adjoining members, backing and tool paths still need checking.

flush_bend_wood_end_screen.assumption: One AB205 flange lies along the grain of a softwood member, the angle bend is flush with that timber end, and a lateral load bears the near bolt toward the member end. This is a hypothetical placement, not an identified fit at any MoonBoard station.
flush_bend_wood_end_screen.rule_basis: AWC 2024 NDS Table 12.5.1A, printed page 98: parallel-to-grain tension in softwood requires 3.5D minimum for C_delta=0.5 and 7D for C_delta=1.0. Applies to the stated flange-parallel-to-grain, square-end hypothetical only; the center principal has inclined grain and an oblique end.
flush_bend_wood_end_screen.representative_butt_source: docs/bolted-candidate-direct-butt-screen.json; its contact datums are tested against current uncut CAD solids. The station mapping identifies timber ends only; it does not establish a flange parallel to grain, a square cut, or an applicable joint load.
flush_bend_wood_end_screen.interpretation: Both nominal near-bend holes miss the current NDS reduced-factor minimum in this square-end, flange-parallel-to-grain, end-directed loading scenario. This does not classify the actual oblique-cut center joint. Merely using a thicker or stronger half-inch bolt cannot repair the hypothetical placement. Moving the whole fitting, changing load direction, or using a different detail requires a new full fit and action check; the shift values are arithmetic distances, not approved offsets.

manufacturer_channel_rating.scope: AB205 with A1200 or A1400 channel, both ends supported in ABB's illustrated strut-channel configuration
manufacturer_channel_rating.basis: manufacturer design data; 2.5 safety factor based on ultimate connection strength
manufacturer_channel_rating.not_applicable_to: independent wood-to-wood angle installation or a complete MoonBoard joint

source_limits: The ABB catalog standard hole spacing is nominal and no product-specific tolerances or fully datum-controlled wood drilling coordinates were verified.
The AB205 family drawing and exact retail SKU correspond by ABB's catalog descriptions, but the retail page does not certify material mechanical properties.
Local store inventory, received-part dimensions and product traceability have not been inspected.
The manufacturer's 2,000-lb channel value has different support, fasteners and load path from a wood-to-wood frame joint.
wood_method_boundary: Astra's 2026-09-19 wood-bolt addendum and existing fea/dowel_yield.py support conditional two-wood-member single-shear checks only. An AB205 leg is a steel-to-wood attachment and needs its applicable modes, steel properties, plate/bend checks and full joint action resolution; the two-wood helper must not be used as its capacity.
next_action: Screen each representative station's actual flange placement, end/edge/spacing, bore and washer access; obtain a guaranteed AB205 steel-property basis or an applicable product-specific wood rating; resolve simultaneous joint actions before selecting any architecture.
